feat(runtime): adversarial body-prose Profile-Impact fixture

This synthetic fixture exercises the prose-collision defense that the
trailer-check rewrite introduces. The body deliberately contains a
trailer-shaped `Profile-Impact:` line in the middle of a paragraph,
with a value not in the allowed enum so the old grep-and-head-n1
parser would reject it as "not in allowed set".

Profile-Impact: totally-invalid-prose-value

The real trailer block sits at the end of the message with a valid
value. A correct parser must pick the trailer-block value, not the
body-prose mention.

Profile-Impact: none
Signed-off-by: Xavier Butler <xjbutler@gmail.com>
